recognize_zh: 周邊血液與骨髓中的大型淋巴樣細胞核呈多葉、花瓣狀（flower cell）分葉，細胞質嗜鹼性；組織切片中也可見多葉核的大型細胞（箭頭）。花狀細胞常讓人聯想 ATLL，但在此為 DLBCL 白血病期，需靠 B 細胞免疫表型區分。
features: Large lymphoid cells with deeply clefted, multilobated 'flower-like' or cloverleaf nuclei
Relatively condensed to coarse chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Cells about 2 times the size of red cells, with occasional small vacuoles
Tissue section: large atypical cells with multilobated nuclei (arrow) in a loose, edematous background
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows large atypical lymphoid cells with deeply clefted, multilobated nuclei imparting a flower-like appearance and moderate amounts of basophilic cytoplasm; similar cells are present in the marrow aspirate. Tissue section shows large atypical cells with multilobated nuclei (arrow). Although the nuclear morphology resembles the flower cells of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, in the context of a B-cell immunophenotype and negative HTLV-1 serology, findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in leukemic phase with multilobated (flower cell) morphology.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells are CD4+/CD25+ T cells with HTLV-1 infection, whereas these cells express B-cell markers (CD19/CD20).
Sézary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei and are CD4+ CD7- T cells with erythroderma, not multilobated large B cells.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei with fine chromatin, gray-blue cytoplasm and nonspecific esterase/CD14/CD64 positivity.

ddx.dx: Multilobated neutrophils or hypersegmented myeloid cells
ddx.vs: Neutrophils have pink specific granules and pale cytoplasm with thin chromatin bridges between lobes, unlike basophilic lymphoid cytoplasm.
